summary: CSRF double-submit cookie regression suite passed. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases green (login sets 3 cookies incl. non-HttpOnly csrf_token; state-change without X-CSRF-Token → 403 'CSRF token required'; matching header+cookie → 200; forged 'evil.evil.evil' pair → 403 'Invalid CSRF token' via HMAC binding; public GET /api/public/salon/{slug} and POST /api/public/ai-chat/hair-hub-system unaffected; POST /api/auth/refresh rotates csrf_token; logout clears cookies and subsequent /me returns 401). Bearer bypass test skipped (login response is cookie-only, no token in body—middleware code path verified visually). Frontend E2E: salon admin login → dismiss What's New → /settings → Owner PIN 4321 → click Save profile (data-testid settings-save-branding-btn) → PUT /api/settings/branding returned 200 with 'Salon Profile saved successfully' toast, proving axios interceptor attaches X-CSRF-Token. Public /book/miracurl-marathahalli renders services and packages with zero 403s. Super admin login to /super-admin succeeded with zero 403 CSRF errors on load.

critical_code_review_comments: CSRF middleware (server.py ~L429) is correctly scoped: safe methods, /api/public/*, /api/webhooks/*, exact login/refresh/passkeys exempt; Bearer bypass short-circuits before cookie check; no-access-cookie requests pass through so route auth returns 401 not misleading 403.
HMAC binding via csrf_token_valid(cookie_val, anchor=sid|sub) correctly rejects forged tokens even when cookie==header.
Refresh keeps foreign-origin check (only enforceable on localhost:8001 per main-agent note) — that's fine.
BranchSwitcher.jsx L78 puts <span> child inside <option> — React hydration warning. Minor, not related to CSRF.
